spans.s:
bhū́r, indec. [vc. of bhū, O earth], one 🞄of the tree vyāhṛtis in the formula bhū́r 🞄bhúvaḥ svâḥ, where it is taken to mean earth;
 🞄when fourteen earths are assumed it is the 🞄first of the ascending series of seven.

bhuraṇ-yá, den. P. (RV.) be restless 🞄or active;
 agitate (liquid).

bhur-íj, f. [moving backwards and 🞄forwards], du. scissors (V.);
 wheelwrightʼs 🞄vice (consisting of two arms which hold the 🞄wood while it is manipulated).

bhū-ruh, m. (springing from the 🞄earth), plant, tree;
 -ruha, m. id..
